primary_claim: LLMs can be fine-tuned to condition their output simultaneously on the semantics of the input/output text and on which of many possible tokenizations was used to represent it, enabling reliable encoding of independent information (e.g. 16 bits, or a selectable function among several) into a token sequence's tokenization pattern that is destroyed when the tokens are converted to decoded text -- implying that auditing an LLM by inspecting decoded text alone is insufficient.

effect.metric: per-bit and full-code accuracy for LoRA-finetuned encoding/decoding of bits via tokenization pattern
effect.value: Encoding: 99.70% per-bit / 98.0% full-code accuracy; Decoding: 99.94% per-bit / 99.5% full-code accuracy (99.6%/98.1% on out-of-distribution messages)

contradicts_or_qualifies: Huang et al. (2024) note that alternative tokenizations are an unaddressed issue for prior LLM-based steganography approaches but do not deliberately exploit them, whereas this work repurposes them
Extends snimu's blog-post observation that Pythia models generate alternative (unmerged) tokenizations depending on sampling temperature
stated_future_work: A much deeper investigation of LLM performance under alternative tokenizations
Investigate why accuracy degradation with longer/altered tokenization appears additive rather than the naively-expected multiplicative accumulation
Investigate the tokenization-driven emotion-rating effect further (author invites mechanistic interpretability collaboration)
limitations_stated: Only Llama 3 family models were used to establish the core learned-function results; not tested across other model families
ARC-Easy tokenization-perturbation results are aggregated and a deeper exploration of the data could yield more nuanced insights
Author cautions against overinterpreting small differences or exact plot shapes as more than very tentative conjectures
Message generation examples shown were lightly cherrypicked for interestingness of content
quote: the models can learn - and quite easily so - to take into account both the semantics of the text and its tokenization pattern.
